d:
Jethalal avoids a costly billing error thanks to an honest client, Kalpesh Seth. Meanwhile, Bagha pulls a ghost prank in the godown that nearly scares Jethalal out of his wits, and Bawri sneaks in while Jethalal is away delivering mangoes to apologize to the client.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
